summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the selected Greek working source; the simplified edition was also compared with the standard. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the denial/confession contrast, obligations, whole-hearted suffering, removal and healing of sins, gift of life, and death-to-God consequences without adding doctrinal conditions. The notes accurately disclose the supplied reports concerning the fruit-reading alternative, bracketed expressions, and partly restored blessing phrase. The imperative interpretation of μακαρίζετε is explicitly identified rather than presented as uniquely established. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure evidence; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
